intent.status: Identified support_tickets and organizations for spike analysis

events.label: Identified support_tickets and organizations for spike analysis

plan.headline: Compare weekly ticket volume to the prior period, then break down by category and priority to show where the spike is concentrated.

metrics.title: Tickets created
metrics.description: Number of support tickets created in the selected period, compared with the previous period of equal length. Excludes tickets from test organizations when that assumption is on.

metrics.title: Weekly ticket volume
metrics.description: Tickets created per week over the selected period, bucketed in the chosen timezone, to show when volume jumped.

metrics.title: Tickets by category
metrics.description: Tickets created in the current period versus the previous period for each category, with the change in count, to show which categories are spiking.

metrics.title: Spike by industry
metrics.description: Tickets created in the current period per customer industry, joined via the ticket's organization, with the change from the previous period, to show which customer segments are driving growth.

assumptions.label: Period
assumptions.rationale: Last 90 days is long enough to show a spike against a baseline while still being recent. It is compared with the preceding 90 days.

assumptions.label: Timezone
assumptions.rationale: Tickets are bucketed by day and week in a single timezone so that boundaries are consistent. UTC is the default because no company timezone is specified.

assumptions.label: Exclude test orgs
assumptions.rationale: The data dictionary says test, demo and load-test tenants should be excluded from business metrics.

events.sql: WITH bounds AS (SELECT (:date_range_start::date)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE :timezone::text AS cur_start, (:date_range_end::date)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE :timezone::text AS cur_end, (:date_range_prev_start::date)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE :timezone::text AS prev_start, (:date_range_prev_end::date)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE :timezone::text AS prev_end), scoped AS (SELECT t.created_at FROM northwind.support_tickets t JOIN northwind.organizations o ON o.id = t.org_id WHERE (NOT :exclude_test_accounts::boolean OR o.is_test = false)) SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.created_at >= b.cur_start AND s.created_at < b.cur_end) AS value, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.created_at >= b.prev_start AND s.created_at < b.prev_end) AS previous_value FROM scoped s CROSS JOIN bounds b
events.explanation: Counts tickets (test orgs excluded per assumption) created in the current period and in the equal-length previous period, using timezone-aware boundaries.

events.sql: WITH weeks AS (SELECT generate_series(date_trunc('week', (:date_range_start::date)::timestamp), date_trunc('week', ((:date_range_end::date) - 1)::timestamp), interval '1 week') AS wk), tickets AS (SELECT date_trunc('week', t.created_at AT TIME ZONE :timezone::text) AS wk, count(*) AS n FROM northwind.support_tickets t JOIN northwind.organizations o ON o.id = t.org_id WHERE t.created_at >= (:date_range_start::date)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE :timezone::text AND t.created_at < (:date_range_end::date)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE :timezone::text AND (NOT :exclude_test_accounts::boolean OR NOT o.is_test) GROUP BY 1) SELECT w.wk::date AS x, COALESCE(k.n, 0) AS y FROM weeks w LEFT JOIN tickets k ON k.wk = w.wk ORDER BY x
events.explanation: Counts tickets per week in the chosen timezone within the period (optionally excluding test orgs), with zero-filled weeks; the first and last weeks may be partial.

events.sql: WITH tickets AS (SELECT t.category, t.created_at FROM northwind.support_tickets t JOIN northwind.organizations o ON o.id = t.org_id WHERE (NOT :exclude_test_accounts::boolean OR NOT o.is_test) AND t.created_at >= (:date_range_prev_start::date)::timestamp at time zone :timezone::text AND t.created_at < (:date_range_end::date)::timestamp at time zone :timezone::text), agg AS (SELECT category, count(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at >= (:date_range_start::date)::timestamp at time zone :timezone::text) AS current_tickets, count(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at < (:date_range_start::date)::timestamp at time zone :timezone::text) AS previous_tickets FROM tickets GROUP BY category) SELECT category, current_tickets, previous_tickets, current_tickets - previous_tickets AS change, CASE WHEN previous_tickets = 0 THEN NULL ELSE round((current_tickets - previous_tickets) * 100.0 / previous_tickets, 1) END AS change_pct FROM agg ORDER BY change DESC, current_tickets DESC
events.explanation: Counts tickets per category in the current and previous equal-length periods (timezone-aware, test orgs optionally excluded), then shows absolute and percent change sorted by largest increase.

events.sql:
WITH t AS (
  SELECT o.industry,
    (st.created_at >= (:date_range_start::date)::timestamp at time zone :timezone::text
      AND st.created_at < (:date_range_end::date)::timestamp at time zone :timezone::text) AS is_current,
    (st.created_at >= (:date_range_prev_start::date)::timestamp at time zone :timezone::text
      AND st.created_at < (:date_range_prev_end::date)::timestamp at time zone :timezone::text) AS is_prev
  FROM northwind.support_tickets st
  JOIN northwind.organizations o ON o.id = st.org_id
  WHERE (NOT :exclude_test_accounts::boolean OR NOT o.is_test)
    AND st.created_at >= (:date_range_prev_start::date)::timestamp at time zone :timezone::text
    AND st.created_at < (:date_range_end::date)::timestamp at time zone :timezone::text
)
SELECT industry AS label,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_current) AS value,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_prev) AS previous_value,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_current) - count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_prev) AS change
FROM t
GROUP BY industry
ORDER BY value DESC, label
LIMIT 20
events.explanation: Counts tickets per organization industry in the current period versus the previous equal-length period (test orgs excluded per assumption), ordered by current count.
